title: Covalent immobilization of proteins onto photoactivated polystyrene microtiter plates for enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay procedures
protocol: Activate polystyrene surface by FNAB under UV light for 15 min at a wavelength of 365 nm.
In activated and untreated polystyrene microtiter plates, immobilize capture molecule \(anti-rabbit IgG, anti-human IgE, Epicoccum nigrum antigen) onto the wells.
Block any remaining reactive sites on the plate.
Add analyte \(rabbit IgG, human IgE, Epicoccum nigrum) to the wells and allow binding.
Wash the plates with washing buffer.
Add secondary antibody-conjugate to the wells and allow binding.
Wash the plates with washing buffer.
Add substrate dye buffer to develop color.
Stop the colour development by adding 50 μl of 2 M NaOH.
Record absorbance at 405 nm in an ELISA reader.
